narrative: They didn't complain. They just started moving workloads. docs/design/demo-narratives.md §3A

communications.text: Heads up — our reserved H100 cluster has been sitting mostly idle for the last three weeks; idle share went from about 12% to 31%. We paused two training runs while the team re-plans the Q2 schedule, so don't be surprised by the utilization numbers this month.

Apologies, we need to push the QBR out again — the team is heads-down on a roadmap reset and I can't get the right people in the room this month. I'll come back with new dates once things settle; I have not been in the console much myself lately for the same reason.

Ticket #4412: We are validating a second provider for a subset of our training jobs and need our checkpoint format exported in a portable layout. Can you confirm whether the object store supports S3-compatible bulk export without egress throttling? We want to run the same workload on both environments for a few weeks.

Capacity check-in with Priya: they have consumed 68% of committed capacity against an 85% plan for the quarter and she does not expect to make up the shortfall. She asked whether the commitment schedule could be revisited before renewal.

We've been looking at what spot H100 capacity goes for elsewhere and the delta to our reserved rate is hard to justify to finance right now. Before we go into renewal I'd like a pricing review — specifically whether the reserved rate can move closer to current market spot pricing.

events.title: Renewal signed at -$1.4M (contraction) — Meridian AI
events.evidence: Renewal order form dated 2026-04-20; committed capacity reduced from $4.1M to $2.7M

communications.text: FYI the reserved cluster idle share is up to 27% this month — we scaled the inference fleet back after the launch crunch. Nothing to act on yet, just flagging that the number will look odd on your side.
Weekly sync skipped twice in a row by the customer; Jordan has not responded on the capacity-planning thread since the 3rd and declined the reschedule.

We're benchmarking the same training job on another provider's cluster this month and want the comparison to be apples to apples. Can you share the exact interconnect topology and NCCL settings you use for our 64-GPU reservation?

Idle share on the reserved cluster spiked to 34% this week — we are midway through migrating the batch-job scheduler and most queued jobs are held until it's done. Expect this to persist for two to three weeks.
Migration is complete and the queue drained over the weekend; utilization is back above plan and the new scheduler is doing what we hoped.
Lena agreed to take a reference call with a prospective research-computing customer and said she would be glad to talk through the migration experience.
Routine monthly review with Ken: ran through the utilization dashboard and the open tickets; nothing flagged, no concerns raised on either side.
